id: 06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT
title: 双控与三地控制照明实验
source_doc: course/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT.md
author_source: project/Basic Electrical Engineering Lab/06_Two Way and Three-Way Control of Lamp Basic Electrical Engineering Laboratory VT/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯口，楼梯上下各有一个开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the foot of a staircase with a light switch at the bottom and another at the top, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课做双控和三地控制照明实验。
overlay: 双控与三地控制照明实验

shots.scene: 一盏灯连着两个开关和三个开关的两组图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: one lamp linked to two switches, and one lamp linked to three switches. No people.
shots.narration: 一盏灯，两处、三处都能开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰走到楼梯顶，回头发现楼下的灯关不了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches the top of a staircase and looks back at a lamp he cannot switch off from downstairs.
shots.narration: 阿杰上了楼，楼下的灯却关不掉。

shots.scene: 小研在楼上按开关，灯灭了
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses a wall switch upstairs and the staircase lamp goes off.
shots.narration: 小研在楼上一按，灯就灭了。

shots.scene: 阿杰惊讶地挠头，欣欣在旁边竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head in surprise while the panda mascot raises one finger beside him.
shots.narration: 秘密就在开关的接法里。

shots.scene: 楼梯上下两个开关控制同一盏灯的示意
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a switch at the bottom and the top, both linked to one ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 双控：两个地点控制同一盏灯。

shots.scene: 卧室门口和床头各一个开关控制吊灯
shots.prompt_en: A bedroom icon with one switch by the door and one by the bed, both linked to the ceiling lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 楼梯常用，卧室也能用。

shots.scene: 两只双控开关之间加了一只中间开关
shots.prompt_en: An intermediate switch added between two two-way switches, all controlling one lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 再加一只中间开关，三个地点控一盏灯。

shots.scene: 花园里三条小路口各有一个开关，控制同一盏灯
shots.prompt_en: A garden icon with three path entrances, each with a switch, all linked to one garden lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 讲解里把它叫作花园布线。

shots.scene: 空白实验记录本上画着两张空表
shots.prompt_en: A blank lab notebook showing two empty table grids. No people.
shots.narration: 目的：实现两地、三地控灯，列出真值表。

shots.scene: 实验台上摆着两只双控开关、一只中间开关、一个灯泡和导线
shots.prompt_en: Two two-way switches, one intermediate switch, an incandescent bulb and connecting wires laid out on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 器材：两只双控开关，一只中间开关。

shots.scene: 开关旁空白铭牌，旁边是电流和电压图标
shots.prompt_en: The switches with blank nameplates, current and voltage icons beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 开关都是五安、二百三十伏。

shots.scene: 白炽灯旁空白铭牌和一卷导线
shots.prompt_en: An incandescent bulb with a blank nameplate next to a coil of connecting wire. No people.
shots.narration: 白炽灯二百三十伏、四十瓦，再加导线。

shots.scene: 电路图：交流电源的相线经熔断器接到第一只开关的公共端
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the live line of an AC supply passes through a fuse to the common terminal of the first switch. No people.
shots.narration: 单相交流电源，相线先经熔断器。

shots.scene: 相线接到开关一的公共端 A
shots.prompt_en: The live line reaching the common terminal of switch one. No people.
shots.narration: 接到开关一的公共端 A。

shots.scene: 两只开关之间两根导线对应相连
shots.prompt_en: Two wires linking the two contacts of switch one to the two contacts of switch two. No people.
shots.narration: B 接 E，C 接 F。

shots.scene: 开关二的公共端接灯，灯另一端接中性线，灯旁标 100 W
shots.prompt_en: The common terminal of switch two goes to the lamp, and the lamp's other end goes to the neutral line. No people.
shots.narration: 开关二公共端 D 接灯，灯再接中性线。

shots.scene: 小研在透明接线板上按图插线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student plugs wires into a transparent patch board following a circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 备齐器材，在接线板上按图接线。

shots.scene: 接好的导线逐根打勾
shots.prompt_en: Each connected wire on the board gets a green check one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 先连 B–E、C–F，再从 D 接灯和中性线。

shots.scene: 小研扳动开关一，灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student flips switch one by its handle and the bulb lights up.
shots.narration: 扳动开关一，灯亮了。

shots.scene: 阿杰扳动开关二，灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips switch two by its handle and the bulb goes out.
shots.narration: 再扳开关二，灯又灭了。

shots.scene: 一张 4 行真值表，只有亮灯和灭灯图标
shots.prompt_en: A four-row truth table grid with only lamp-on and lamp-off icons. No people.
shots.narration: 把四种开关状态记成真值表。

shots.scene: 两开关同侧时灯亮，异侧时灯灭
shots.prompt_en: Two switch icons on the same side with a lit lamp, and on opposite sides with a dark lamp. No people.
shots.narration: 两开关位置对应，灯亮；错开，灯灭。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条平行连线
shots.prompt_en: An intermediate switch with two parallel internal links. No people.
shots.narration: 中间开关第一种状态：直连。

shots.scene: 中间开关内部两条交叉连线
shots.prompt_en: An intermediate switch with two crossed internal links. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种状态：交叉连接。

shots.scene: 直连和交叉同时出现的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon showing both parallel and crossed links at once, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 两种状态，不能同时成立。

shots.scene: 电路图：相线接 A，开关一的 B、C 接到中间开关一侧
shots.prompt_en: A circuit diagram icon: the live line to switch one, whose two contacts go to one side of the intermediate switch. No people.
shots.narration: 相线接 A，B 接 P，C 接 R。

shots.scene: 中间开关另一侧连到开关二，开关二接灯
shots.prompt_en: The other side of the intermediate switch links to switch two, which goes to the lamp and neutral. No people.
shots.narration: Q 接 E，S 接 F，D 接灯再接中性线。

shots.scene: 老周戴着腕表，徒手在接线板上加装中间开关并插线
shots.prompt_en: The older man, wearing a metal wristwatch, plugs wires bare-handed into a patch board to add an intermediate switch.
shots.narration: 先连开关一到中间开关，再连到开关二。

shots.scene: 老周接上灯和中性线
shots.prompt_en: The older man connects the lamp and the neutral wire on the patch board.
shots.narration: 再接灯和中性线。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳上、扳下两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons of the intermediate switch lever: up and down. No people.
shots.narration: 扳上是直连，扳下是交叉。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳上，阿杰轮流扳动两只双控开关
shots.prompt_en: With the intermediate switch up, the young male student flips the two two-way switches in turn by their handles.
shots.narration: 先在直连状态下，扳动两只开关。

shots.scene: 中间开关扳下，再轮流扳动
shots.prompt_en: With the intermediate switch down, the young male student flips the two switches again while the female graduate student records.
shots.narration: 再换成交叉状态，重复一遍。

shots.scene: 一张 8 行真值表，上半与下半用颜色区分
shots.prompt_en: An eight-row table with the top half shaded one color and the bottom half another, only lamp icons in the last column. No people.
shots.narration: 三地控制，一共八种状态。

shots.scene: 上半表亮灭顺序与双控相同，下半表完全相反
shots.prompt_en: The top half shows lamp on, off, off, on; the bottom half shows off, on, on, off. No people.
shots.narration: 直连和双控一样，交叉正好相反。

shots.scene: 亮灯图标旁是 1，灭灯旁是 0
shots.prompt_en: A lit lamp icon next to the digit one and a dark lamp icon next to the digit zero. No people.
shots.narration: 亮记 1，灭记 0，逻辑一目了然。

shots.scene: 大仓库里三个门口各有一个开关
shots.prompt_en: A large warehouse icon with a switch at each of three doors, all linked to the hall lights. No people.
shots.narration: 大仓库、粮库，多处都要能开关灯。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两地和三地控制的两张图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the two-way and three-way control diagrams on a board.
shots.narration: 双控两地控灯，加中间开关三地控灯。

shots.scene: 房屋图标里的楼梯灯
shots.prompt_en: A house icon with a staircase lamp highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 弄懂开关逻辑，家里布线也明白了。

shots.scene: 双控和三地控制两张电路图
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit diagram icons: two-way control and three-place control. No people.
shots.narration: 双控两只开关，三地再加中间开关。

shots.scene: 4 行和 8 行两张真值表
shots.prompt_en: A four-row truth table and an eight-row truth table with lamp icons. No people.
shots.narration: 真值表：双控四种，三地八种。

shots.scene: 房屋图标里的楼梯灯和开关逻辑图标
shots.prompt_en: A house icon with a staircase lamp and a small switch logic icon. No people.
shots.narration: 理解开关逻辑，家庭布线也用得上。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在楼梯中间，按下开关，灯亮，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands halfway up a staircase, presses a switch, the lamp lights up, and she waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 哪里都能开关灯，下次见！
